items.name: The first stamping of a slice hands out its identities in file order
items.rule: A slice's first stamping hands out its item identities from 1, in file order

items.name: The slice is the directory name up to its first dash, verbatim
items.rule: A slice's first stamping hands out its item identities from 1, in file order

items.name: A deleted scenario's number is never handed out again
items.rule: Stamping again continues the slice's numbering and never reuses a number

items.name: Stamping twice changes nothing
items.rule: Stamping again continues the slice's numbering and never reuses a number

items.name: Rewording a scenario keeps its item identity
items.rule: Stamping again continues the slice's numbering and never reuses a number

items.name: No spec found for a slice never stamped
items.rule: Stamping refuses a spec it cannot read as the slice's own

items.name: A spec that went missing is "no spec found", never "fully stamped"
items.rule: Stamping refuses a spec it cannot read as the slice's own

items.name: Only the file's unstamped scenarios, in file order, are stamped
items.rule: Stamping refuses a spec it cannot read as the slice's own

items.name: A Scenario heading with nothing after the colon is reported, not stamped
items.rule: An empty-title heading is not an item, and the stamper says so out loud

items.name: A stamping that hides an empty-title heading is refused
items.rule: An empty-title heading is not an item, and the stamper says so out loud

items.name: A Scenario Outline is stamped and a Scenario Template is not
items.rule: One reading of Gherkin decides what is a scenario and what stamps it

items.name: A heading whose title is only whitespace is a scenario
items.rule: One reading of Gherkin decides what is a scenario and what stamps it

items.name: A stamped item's title is the heading's title with surrounding whitespace stripped
items.rule: One reading of Gherkin decides what is a scenario and what stamps it

items.name: An item tag separated from its heading by a blank line does not stamp it
items.rule: One reading of Gherkin decides what is a scenario and what stamps it

items.name: Tags that are not item tags do not make a scenario stamped
items.rule: One reading of Gherkin decides what is a scenario and what stamps it
